style: Minimal, elegant modern tech product film score. Soft felt piano, warm analog synth pads, gentle sub bass. Key of D major, 90 BPM. Clean, spacious, polished mix. No vocals.

cues.prompt: Opening. Sparse and contemplative, a little unresolved and restless: single felt piano notes over a quiet low drone, leaning to B minor. Even level from start to end, no fade in, no fade out.
A soft warm swell opens into brightness, like a reveal, then a gentle forward eighth-note synth pulse begins. Hopeful and light. Even level after the swell, no fade out.
Focused and thoughtful, two minds working through a problem: a soft ticking arpeggio pulse, light muted percussion, quiet tension building very slowly. Even level, no fade out.
Resolution: opens on a warm, satisfying major chord, then a calm, confident groove with soft piano and pads. Even level, no fade out.
Calm confidence, in control: a steady gentle pulse with a soft piano motif, light and assured. Even level, no fade out.
Finale: warm and uplifting, fuller pads and piano building gently, then ending on one clean final chord that rings out over the last four seconds.
